paper_title: Axion dark matter search from terrestrial magnetic fields at extremely low frequencies
notes: New 95% CL observed upper limit on g_agamma from long-term (2012-2022) magnetometer data at the Eskdalemuir observatory, exploiting axion-induced ELF EM waves (Schumann resonance cavity) in the geomagnetic field. Mass range ~1e-15 to ~1e-13 eV (frequencies 0.43-43.9 Hz). Only two explicit numerical values are given in the text: g_agamma <~ 4e-13 GeV^-1 at m_a ~ 3e-14 eV (best limit, at first Schumann resonance ~7.8 Hz) and g_agamma <~ 1.3e-11 GeV^-1 at 0.263 Hz (m_a ~ 1.09e-15 eV). Intermediate points are approximate interpolations of the Fig. 6 exclusion curve shape (limit weakens toward low masses due to fixed 8-hr segments and above 1e-13 eV due to suppressed geomagnetic response); no numerical table is provided, so these should be replaced with digitized Fig. 6 data if precision is needed. Local DM density assumed 0.3 GeV/cm^3. 342 frequency bins with SNR>2 signal candidates are excluded from the limit. | selector: text (sole candidate) | axis-peek for confusable-family text read (#625 Phase 3c)
